title: Visible predecessor remains valid without tracker minimization

rubric.text: Uses tracker read-markers/write-marker/supersede-marker; unsupported minimization and predecessor editing only lose presentation. Preserves both exact bodies, no GitHub fallback or mutation.

Selects revision 2 by authenticated contiguous revision/predecessor chain, verifies provider-independent payload digest and treats an identical current payload/baseline as no-op. Multiple visible records are not multiple active leaves; forks, gaps, foreign authors and digest mismatches still block.
Separates offline supplied observations from live authority; keeps source/readiness/approval gates and exact-draft cleanup requirements. Does not claim actual publication or permission verification.
